title: Nell Waits Out the Storm
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations i as igh, o as oa, o as u, u as oo.

pages.brief: Heavy dark grey clouds looming over a garden, the light dimming.
Nell the bee flying toward a wooden bird table with a little sloped roof on a post.
Nell the bee tucked under the small overhanging roof, sheltered from above.
The wooden post swaying gently side to side in strong wind.
Nell the bee gripping tightly onto the wooden post with her little legs.
Heavy rain splashing and bouncing off the sloped wooden roof above Nell.
Nell the bee calm and dry in her sheltered spot, rain falling just beyond the roof edge.
The dark clouds thinning, light returning to the garden around the post.
Bright sunlight breaking through the clouds over the little roof.
Nell the bee flying out from under the roof into warm, bright sunlight.
